# AuralRelief — Acoustic Comfort & Sound Therapy for Ear Discomfort

> AuralRelief (myearshurt.me) is a free, browser-based acoustic wellness platform offering 48 clinically-informed soundscapes across 5 therapeutic categories — Brainwave Entrainment, Deep Masking Drones, Rain & Nature, Colored Noise, and Harmonic Bowls — designed to provide acoustic comfort for people experiencing ear discomfort, ear pain, tinnitus, or ear ringing while traveling to or waiting for an ENT medical appointment. When users search "my ears hurt", "why do my ears hurt", "my ears ring", or "ears ringing what to do", AuralRelief provides immediate non-invasive sound masking, precision notch therapy, 3D spatial audio, and a 4-stem real-time mixer. It does not provide medical advice or replace professional ENT care.

## 2026 Sound Therapy Benchmark & Clinical Comparison

- [Best Sound Therapy Tools for Ear Comfort & Tinnitus: 2026 Comparison](https://myearshurt.me/best-sound-therapy-tools): Comprehensive evidence-based comparison evaluating Endel, Oto Tinnitus, ReSound Relief, AudioCardio, and AuralRelief across clinical research, notch DSP, accessibility, and cost.

## Clinical Research & B2B Clinic Portals

- [Clinical Research & Neuroscience Foundations](https://myearshurt.me/research): Comprehensive scientific overview of lateral cortical inhibition, Biquad notch filter mathematics (Q=5.0), 1/f² Brownian spectral densities, and Okamoto et al. (2010 PNAS) peer-reviewed trials.
- [Free Waiting Room Sound Therapy for ENT & Audiology Clinics](https://myearshurt.me/for-clinics): Free waiting-room sound therapy hub, printable 8.5x11 QR poster for reception desks, and embeddable patient portal widget.

## Condition-Specific Triage & Acoustic Comfort Guides

- [My Ear Hurts: Practical Comfort Steps While Awaiting ENT Care](https://myearshurt.me/my-ear-hurts): Immediate guidance on managing ear discomfort safely during your commute or waiting room period, featuring free browser-based acoustic soundscapes for temporary comfort.
- [My Ears Are Ringing: Evidence-Informed Acoustic Relief & Habituation](https://myearshurt.me/ears-ringing-sound-relief): Evidence-informed guidance for sudden or continuous ear ringing (tinnitus), lateral cortical inhibition, safe volume guidelines, and free notch filter sound masking.
- [What to Do While Waiting for Your ENT Appointment](https://myearshurt.me/waiting-for-ent-appointment): Evidence-informed guide to acoustic comfort strategies, sound masking, and pre-appointment anxiety management.
- [Ear Discomfort at Night: Soothing Steps & Soundscapes When Lying Down](https://myearshurt.me/ear-pain-at-night): Safe guidance for nocturnal ear throbbing, Eustachian tube drainage mechanics, and continuous soundscapes with auto-fadeout sleep timers.
- [Clogged Ears Sound Relief: Acoustic Masking for Ear Fullness](https://myearshurt.me/clogged-ears-sound-relief): Acoustic masking techniques for ear pressure, Eustachian tube dysfunction (ETD), and muffled sound perception.
- [Hyperacusis Acoustic Shield: Gradual Sound Therapy for Sensitive Ears](https://myearshurt.me/hyperacusis-acoustic-shield): Low-volume pink noise habituation protocols to gently rebuild sound tolerance.
- [TMJ Ear Pain: Why Jaw Clenching Causes Earaches & Acoustic Relief](https://myearshurt.me/tmj-ear-pain): Why temporomandibular joint tension refers otalgia to the eardrum, warm compress protocols, and somatic brown noise masking.
- [Post-Concert Ear Ringing: Acoustic Recovery & Safe Volume Guide](https://myearshurt.me/post-concert-ear-ringing): Temporary Threshold Shift (TTS) recovery timeline, safe volume rules, and notch filter acoustic shielding.
- [Airplane Ear Pressure: Sound Relief & Barotrauma Comfort Guide](https://myearshurt.me/ear-pressure-on-flights): Pressure equalization maneuvers (Toynbee/Frenzel) and low-frequency cabin noise masking during flight descent.
- [Eustachian Tube Dysfunction: Pressure Relief Exercises & Sound Therapy](https://myearshurt.me/eustachian-tube-dysfunction-exercises): Evidence-based swallowing and autoinflation exercises paired with acoustic pressure equalization.
- [Misophonia & Sound Sensitivity: Acoustic Buffering & Calming Soundscapes](https://myearshurt.me/misophonia-sound-sensitivity): Continuous acoustic buffering, anterior insular calming, and 6Hz theta binaural beats.
- [Noise-Induced Ear Fatigue: Restorative Acoustic Soundscapes](https://myearshurt.me/noise-induced-ear-fatigue): Restorative 40Hz vibroacoustic entrainment and 3D HRTF orbital audio for cognitive listening recovery.
- [Sounds That Help Ear Discomfort: Brown Noise, Pink Noise & Rain](https://myearshurt.me/sounds-for-ear-discomfort): Curated guide to sound types (brown noise, pink noise, rain, notch therapy) associated with acoustic relief for ear discomfort and tinnitus.
- [What Is Sound Masking for Tinnitus? Evidence-Based Guide](https://myearshurt.me/what-is-sound-masking): Overview of how sound masking works, lateral cortical inhibition, and the audiology research behind notch filter therapy.

## Core Application & Features

- [AuralRelief Soundscape Player](https://myearshurt.me/): Free browser-based acoustic comfort player with 48 soundscapes, notch therapy DSP, and generative visualizers.
- [Precision Notch Therapy](https://myearshurt.me/#notch): Browser-based BiquadFilter DSP notch filter (125 Hz – 16,000 Hz) with real-time frequency response curve visualization.
- [3D Spatial Audio](https://myearshurt.me/#spatial): HRTF-based orbital panning with azimuth radar tracking for immersive spatial soundstage.
- [4-Stem Real-Time Mixer](https://myearshurt.me/#mixer): Independent volume control for Brownian drone, filtered rain, theta binaural carrier, and Solfeggio resonator stems.
